title: Gluing exact adjunctions on inverse section categories
statement:
Let $\mathcal A_n,\mathcal B_n$ ($n\ge1$) be abelian categories [def-sp-abelian], with exact additive transition functors $r_n:\mathcal A_n\to\mathcal A_{n+1}$ and $s_n:\mathcal B_n\to\mathcal B_{n+1}$. Define $\operatorname{Sect}(\mathcal A,r)$ to have objects $(X_n,x_n:X_{n+1}\to r_nX_n)$ and morphisms $(f_n)$ satisfying $r_n(f_n)x_n=x'_nf_{n+1}$; define $\operatorname{Sect}(\mathcal B,s)$ similarly. Suppose additive exact functors $L_n:\mathcal A_n\to\mathcal B_n$ and $P_n:\mathcal B_n\to\mathcal A_n$ have adjunctions $L_n\dashv P_n$ with units $\eta_n$ and counits $\varepsilon_n$. Supply natural isomorphisms $\alpha_n:L_{n+1}r_n\xrightarrow{\sim}s_nL_n$ and $\beta_n:P_{n+1}s_n\xrightarrow{\sim}r_nP_n$. Require, for $X\in\mathcal A_n$ and $Y\in\mathcal B_n$,
$$\beta_{n,L_nX}\,P_{n+1}(\alpha_{n,X})\,\eta_{n+1,r_nX}=r_n(\eta_{n,X}),$$
$$\varepsilon_{n+1,s_nY}=s_n(\varepsilon_{n,Y})\,\alpha_{n,P_nY}\,L_{n+1}(\beta_{n,Y}),$$
where compositions are read right to left. Then these section categories are abelian with componentwise exactness. The formulas
$$(LX)_n=L_nX_n,\quad (LX)_{n+1}\to s_n(LX)_n=\alpha_{n,X_n}L_{n+1}(x_n),$$
$$(PY)_n=P_nY_n,\quad (PY)_{n+1}\to r_n(PY)_n=\beta_{n,Y_n}P_{n+1}(y_n)$$
define exact additive functors $L,P$ and an adjunction $L\dashv P$. Its unit and counit are the actual families $(\eta_{n,X_n})_n$ and $(\varepsilon_{n,Y_n})_n$, and its Hom bijection is componentwise transposition $f_n\mapsto P_n(f_n)\eta_{n,X_n}$, with inverse $g_n\mapsto\varepsilon_{n,Y_n}L_n(g_n)$. Both families satisfy the section-transition equations and both triangle identities as section maps. In particular this applies to strict semilinear module systems [def-coef-semilinear-system-models], with $r_n,s_n$ restriction of scalars [def-pc-sheaf-restrict-scalars]; no invertibility of the system transitions is assumed.
